messages.author: 7bc22c47656aa13f
messages.subject: Distributing R scripts
parts:
Hello,

in the interest of making things modular I am wrtiting functions in a source file say func.r. 

now if I want this file func.r to be available across all nodes so that I can use 

source("func.r") 

in the map function, how do I do it ? 

any pointers would be great.

-Raj

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Re: Distributing R scripts
parts:
in rhipe you can use shared parameter.

i.e. rhmr( ..., shared="path-to-func.R'"


where path to func.R is on the HDFS.

biogenereics.R most likely issues several messages. Use a sprinkling of
suppressMessages suppressPackageStartupMessages suppressWarnings

(most likelye the 2nd one)
